annotations.title: Search nursing homes by ownership type

description: Find certified US nursing homes by ownership type (ProviderInfo.ownership). The result rows match a facility search. Combine with state, city, ZIP, or address.

address.description: Street address with city and state, or a street and ZIP. Geocoded by the Census Bureau as the distance origin. A city, place name, or ZIP alone will not match.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

ownership.description: CMS ownership type. Case-insensitive. Prefixes For profit, Non profit, and Government match that kind. Exact values from list_distinct_values field=ownership, e.g. "For profit - Limited Liability company".

name: search_facilities_by_ownership
